text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Year-end, the Arima Kinen. With T.M. Opera 
O and Meisho Doto—two stars representing 
their era— gathered for the winter Grand 
Prix race—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road had also been chosen to 
enter the race. Welcomed by thunderous 
cheers, she stepped into the paddock 
alongside her generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the result was a crushing defeat: 
T.M. Opera O took 1st, Meisho Doto took 
2nd, and Narita Top Road fell far behind 
in 9th place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she will never give up. With a 
smile, she says she will keep stubbornly 
fighting and struggling on harder than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega also replied that she placed 
high expectations on Narita Top Road, 
which was why she wanted her to rise to 
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like stars shining brilliantly even in the 
midday sky— the era charted by the four 
stars will not end.
